text:
alex: pinging for reviews on PR #5891 — scheduling heuristic change that reduces batch wait but might affect tail latency. hoping for one more LH approval before merge. small canary running.

mei: on it. can you paste the canary numbers? curious about p95/p99

alex: sure — canary run on staging-4 (2 nodes, A100). baseline vs branch 10k requests: 
```
metric    baseline   branch   delta
p50       12.1ms     11.8ms   -2.5%
p95       86.2ms     89.9ms   +4.3%
p99       215ms      248ms    +15.3%
mean      45ms       49ms     +8.9%
```
notes: branch batches slightly more aggressively, reduced overall tokens/sec cost by ~6%.

sam: p99 up 15% is concerning. is that visible as per-model tail or specific seq lengths?

alex: looks tied to long-seq (>=1024) requests — KV cache hit pattern changes. attaching heatmap and allocation snapshot link: <https://go/reports/allocs/5891>

mei: can we run with kv-cache warmup enabled (the flag we used in prev longseq fix)? quick A/B to confirm

alex: yep queued a quick canary with kv_warmup=true. infra-bot will post results.

infra-bot: canary 1818301295 completed — baseline vs branch+warmup: 
```
p95  baseline 87.0ms branch+warmup 83.1ms (-4.5%)
p99  baseline 216ms  branch+warmup 221ms (+2.3%)
```

mei: okay that's better but p99 still slightly up. what's memory delta?

alex: mem-snapshot: branch +warmup adds ~120MB per worker at peak on 40k token buffer (A100). Link: <https://go/reports/memsnap/5891>

sam: that mem bump is non-trivial for dense fleets. can we gate rollout behind a config flag and add a fallback to previous scheduler when p99 > 10%?

alex: yes planning rollout with config gate and automatic fallback to old heuristic if tail exceeds threshold. created PR note and rollout plan in the PR description.

mei: I'll do a final review focusing on fallback metrics and tests. can you add unit that simulates longseq churn?

alex: adding test now — will push in 15m. if no objections I want to merge after CI passes and we observe no p99 >20% on staging for 1 hour.

sam: lgtm if tests + fallback present. cc @eng-sre for rollout watch

ci-bot: ci passed on branch (unit + integration) — 28/28

alex: pushed tests and updated PR. merging after 1h observation window. thanks all :thumbsup:
